insights.one_liner: Liberi Group is a roughly 20-person life sciences business development and strategy consultancy in Heemstede, currently posting two English-language entry-level roles.

culture.text: A small team of about 20 people (11-50 range) based in Heemstede, working on life sciences investment and partnering.
Staff mostly come from Utrecht University, VU Amsterdam, Leiden University, Hogeschool Leiden and the University of Amsterdam, often with natural or biomedical sciences and business backgrounds.
Most people work in consulting, business development and research roles.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Both of its current jobs here (entry level, sales and consulting) don't ask for Dutch.
Describes itself as an international consultancy based in Europe.
